shots.title: KELPIE
shots.subtitle: The Shape of Patience
shots.narration: Markets keep moving, but your liquidity occupies a chosen place. Kelpie begins with that tension: a changing price, and the boundaries you decide to set around it.
shots.camera: Render natively in the subtitle's format throughout, without upscaling or frame interpolation. Rise beneath a submerged stone shelf, tracking through kelp toward the horse's amber eye as the surface bends overhead.
shots.action: Use the official Water Horse design: long equine snout, elongated ears, kelp mane, amber eye, and equine anatomy. Its mane unfurls through midnight reflections threaded with amber. Throughout, use Kokoro Heart documentary narration, leaving an opening breath and a closing score-led movement passage. Begin with bowed bass and water texture; never freeze or loop the geometry.

shots.title: The Edge of Use
shots.subtitle: Illustrative price and liquidity range
shots.narration: Concentrated liquidity works within a selected price range. When price leaves those boundaries, the practical question is not simply where to move, but when movement is justified.
shots.camera: Travel beneath the horse's extended muzzle, following a mane strand into its reflection. Pass through the reflected surface and level beside a straight submerged price rail.
shots.action: The strand straightens into an amber range bracket with visibly separated boundaries. A pale upright blade, labeled price, travels along the rail and slips beyond the bracket. Keep all geometry schematic, without values or market traces. Midnight ripples continue through the empty interval as hollow wooden pulses enter beneath the closing movement.

shots.title: Choices Before the Opening
shots.subtitle: Choose pool, range width, and delay
shots.narration: Kelpie is a concentrated-liquidity manager on Sui. You choose the pool, the range width, and the delay, establishing the parameters that shape how your position can be managed.
shots.camera: Follow the price rail through a rising water curtain into pale daylight. Climb diagonally between suspended stone fins, revealing a physical arrangement of pool, width, and delay elements.
shots.action: A pool channel, rigid width bracket, and folded waiting ribbon slide into an open position cradle. Engrave their parameter names directly into the materials; show no balances, numerical settings, or dashboard. The Water Horse's long-eared silhouette moves behind the translucent curtain. Airy strings replace the opening bass as the cradle approaches closure.

shots.title: A Venue Once Chosen
shots.subtitle: SuiDex V3 and Cetus; venue fixed at opening
shots.narration: Supported venues include SuiDex V3 and Cetus, but the venue is fixed when the position opens. Management does not move that position between exchanges as conditions change.
shots.camera: Slide laterally through narrow architectural gaps, revealing separate venue landings. Follow the selected pool's channel into its landing, then descend beside the closing position cradle.
shots.action: Place the supported venue names from the subtitle on separate landings. The user's selected pool leads to its venue; the cradle dovetails into that foundation at opening. Keep the alternative landing disconnected, with no routing arrows or transfer bridge. Water continues beneath the fixed foundation, accompanied by a muted struck-stone accent.

shots.title: Authority With Clear Edges
shots.subtitle: Owner control; bounded keeper management
shots.narration: Ownership stays with you; the keeper receives bounded management authority. The distinction matters: permission to carry out defined actions is not permission to take over your position.
shots.camera: Descend through the foundation's open underside and track along an amber tether. Enter a cutaway channel where a management carriage moves inside a visibly bounded slot.
shots.action: Label the tether's anchor owner and the constrained carriage keeper. Keep the owner connection continuous while the carriage slides only within its permitted track; do not depict ownership transferring. Cobalt water presses through gaps in the surrounding structure. A dry metallic resonance emphasizes the carriage's limits, then yields to the flowing tether reflection.

shots.title: The Span You Select
shots.subtitle: Width defines a span, not a promise
shots.narration: Range width defines the span of prices you select. It is a practical parameter to examine, rather than a promise that your liquidity will remain in range.
shots.camera: Emerge beside the tether into a pale-water gallery. Truck across suspended reference brackets of differing widths, then push between the boundaries of the selected bracket.
shots.action: Keep the opened position's bracket rigid and unchanged. Detached reference brackets rise beside it as illustrative parameter studies, not edits to the position. A pale price blade travels through and beyond the selected interval while water combs along its edges. Plucked harmonics leave audible space around the final clause.

shots.title: Time Is a Condition
shots.subtitle: Chosen delay, illustrated in compressed time
shots.narration: Your chosen delay adds a condition of time. A price moving outside the range is not, by itself, permission for Kelpie to immediately move the position elsewhere.
shots.camera: Track screen-right parallel to the price rail as the blade exits the range. Lower toward an open waiting channel beside the stationary bracket, keeping the escaped blade visible.
shots.action: An amber filament begins winding through the waiting channel while the range remains fixed. Treat the winding as qualitative, compressed-time illustration, never a measured countdown. The keeper carriage waits behind a closed permission gate. Sustain a low bowed tone without clock ticks; let passing water carry the closing passage.

shots.title: A Crossing Is Insufficient
shots.subtitle: Returning early does not satisfy persistence
shots.narration: If price returns before the delay has elapsed, that departure has not satisfied the waiting condition. The boundary is real, but crossing it is not enough alone.
shots.camera: Retreat along the established rail as the price blade moves back toward the bracket. Slip beneath the near boundary and rise inside the interval without reversing screen orientation.
shots.action: Return the blade inside before the waiting filament completes its path. The incomplete filament loosens into water; the permission gate never opens and the range never moves. Horse-mane reflections drift over the rail without touching the mechanism. Remove the musical pulse on the return, leaving a widening hiss of water beneath the unfinished waiting channel.

shots.title: When Waiting Becomes Permission
shots.subtitle: Persistent out-of-range conditions permit the re-range
shots.narration: Only an out-of-range condition that persists through your chosen delay permits this re-range. That is a threshold for bounded management, not a requirement to chase every market movement.
shots.camera: Advance through the open center of the waiting channel during a fresh departure. Follow the winding filament toward the permission gate, retaining the outside price blade in the background.
shots.action: Keep price outside throughout the illustrated wait. The filament completes its path and unlatches a gate marked eligible, while the range remains stationary through the shot. Show permission becoming available, not compulsory immediate execution. A low note blooms gently as the gate opens; carry its reflection forward into the next scene.

shots.title: Same Width, New Location
shots.subtitle: Same width, single-sided re-range, no swap
shots.narration: When permitted, the position can be re-ranged at the same width, single-sided, without a swap. The range changes location; its span is preserved, rather than widened to follow.
shots.camera: Dolly parallel to the rigid bracket, matching its translation along the rail. Keep both boundaries and the price blade beyond its leading edge visible throughout the move.
shots.action: Translate the intact bracket toward the escaped price blade, stopping wholly on the same side of it. Preserve its span with an unchanging crossbar and carry its single-sided material unchanged. Never cross the blade, widen the bracket, or depict asset conversion. Pale wakes trail the movement as the score opens into a transparent sustained chord.

shots.title: A Move Without Exchange
shots.subtitle: Repositioning without exchanging assets
shots.narration: Single-sided means the re-range uses one side of the pool pair, without swapping between the assets. This is a constrained repositioning mechanism, not an unrestricted trading strategy.
shots.camera: Drop beneath the translated bracket and pass through its transparent floor. Follow the carried material lengthwise, then emerge beside the unchanged crossbar with the outside price blade still visible.
shots.action: Represent the carried asset as a continuous amber strip beside an empty contrasting asset channel. Keep its material identity unchanged from departure to arrival; include no exchange arrows, conversion chamber, or balancing animation. Water flows around the settled bracket, maintaining motion after repositioning ends. Use quiet glass harmonics rather than a transaction chime.

shots.title: Limits Are Not Certainty
shots.subtitle: Markets remain uncertain
shots.narration: These limits make the process understandable, not certain. Kelpie does not promise returns or keep price inside your range; market exposure remains part of providing concentrated liquidity.
shots.camera: Leave the bracket along a gathering wave trough. Rise beside the Water Horse's moving foreleg and climb toward its long profile as the mechanism recedes beneath the surface.
shots.action: The horse walks through midnight water while the distant price blade continues moving independently of the range. Waves pass over the bounded mechanism without any protective dome or calming intervention. Preserve the amber eye and streaming kelp mane against unstable reflections. Thin the score to an unsettled bowed texture, allowing the water to remain dominant.

shots.title: A Memory of Pools
shots.subtitle: Hourly pool observations
shots.narration: Memory gives those parameter choices a past to examine. Kelpie records hourly pool observations, creating historical context for comparing settings instead of relying only on the present moment.
shots.camera: Follow a kelp strand down into a submerged memory gallery. Thread forward between translucent observation fins as they lift sequentially from the pool surface.
shots.action: Each fin carries an abstract relief impression labeled as an hourly observation, not numerical data. Arrange the rising fins into a continuous historical sequence while the water beneath them keeps changing. Include no current timestamps, prices, or fabricated measurements. Introduce spaced felt-piano notes, letting their decay accompany the fins' slow elevation.

shots.title: Observation Is Not Action
shots.subtitle: Memory and management are distinct
shots.narration: An observation is a record, not an instruction to act. Hourly memory supports historical comparison; it does not mean that positions must move, or that archives publish every hour.
shots.camera: Slide through the gaps between observation fins toward daylight above the gallery. Tilt downward while advancing, revealing a separate position rail and a closed record-holding tray beneath them.
shots.action: Continue lifting observation fins while the position bracket stays unchanged and the holding tray sends nothing outward. Maintain visible physical separation between observation, management, and publication paths. The horse's elongated ears pass in silhouette beyond the pale surface. Let a quiet rippling arpeggio accompany the camera's emergence, without action-confirmation sounds.

shots.title: The Midnight Seal
shots.subtitle: Daily records seal at midnight
shots.narration: At midnight, the daily records seal. That daily boundary turns accumulated observations into a closed record, separating the rhythm of collecting history from the rhythm of preserving it.
shots.camera: Descend along the observation stack as its leaves gather into a flat folio. Follow the folio's edge through a narrowing seam, then track beside the receiving rack.
shots.action: At a seam marked midnight, fold the accumulated hourly leaves into a daily record and close its edge with an amber seal. Slide the sealed folio into a local holding rack; show no outward publication yet. Midnight reflections sweep over the moving rack. Sound a muted sealing impact, then leave a deliberate hush over continued water motion.

shots.title: A Different Publication Rhythm
shots.subtitle: Sealed records reach Walrus within the week
shots.narration: Those sealed daily records go onto Walrus within the week, not every hour. Keeping these schedules distinct helps you understand what the archive contains, and when it arrives.
shots.camera: Travel beside the holding rack through a long, bending corridor. After its transit, accelerate gently alongside a sealed folio as it leaves the rack and approaches a distant archival plane.
shots.action: Use the corridor's intervening travel to separate sealing from later publication, without implying an exact upload day. Transfer sealed daily folios into a broad slate structure marked Walrus; never dispatch individual hourly leaves. Keep the publication window legible in the subtitle. Low choral breath expands beneath the transfer while cobalt reflections continue across the stored folios.

shots.title: Compare Before You Choose
shots.subtitle: Historical comparison, not prediction
shots.narration: Historical comparison lets you examine different widths and delays against past pool observations. It can inform a decision, but yesterday's behavior cannot establish what tomorrow's market will do.
shots.camera: Pass through a translucent archived folio into a pale-water comparison gallery. Traverse diagonally across parallel study channels, descending between their fixed-width brackets and suspended waiting ribbons.
shots.action: Carry the same schematic historical ribbon through the study channels while displaying different bracket spans and waiting-path lengths. Label the arrangement illustrative historical comparison. Show no computed returns, winning lane, outcome scores, or invented datasets. Water sheets peel between the channels as interleaved woodwind phrases remain equal in weight, favoring no setting.

shots.title: Read the Rules Clearly
shots.subtitle: kelpie.network/docs · kelpie.network/backtest · kelpie.network/guide · dex.suidex.org/pools/v3/guide
shots.narration: Use Kelpie's guide and backtest to examine the mechanism before choosing parameters. Ask what each setting permits, how long it waits, and whether those limits fit your intentions.
shots.camera: Dolly between upright translucent pages, easing into a near-frontal lateral glide. Keep the source-address plane readable while deeper pages slide past with strong dimensional separation.
shots.action: Engrave the subtitle's source addresses as separate, clearly readable lines beside the open comparison channel. Keep this typography stable through the narration while pages and water continue moving behind it. The channel folds into an amber path leading toward the Water Horse. Pare the score back to water and a quiet sustained string, then follow the path onward.

shots.title: The Boundaries Stay Yours
shots.subtitle: Your choices; bounded management; historical context
shots.narration: The practical payoff is a clearer division of responsibility: you choose the boundaries, the keeper operates within them, and recorded history helps you compare choices without promising the future.
shots.camera: Crane backward through an opening arch as the Water Horse advances. Descend until its hoof reflections fill the frame, then skim outward along the amber thread toward a pale horizon.
shots.action: Memory folios rise into open architectural ribs above midnight water while range rails extend below at unchanged separation. The horse advances between them, its long snout and kelp mane clearly silhouetted. Preserve the owner tether as the bounded carriage recedes behind. Expand the score into restrained bowed strings, carrying the unbroken amber thread toward daylight.

shots.title: Kelpie.network
shots.subtitle: Choose your range. Set your rhythm.
shots.narration: The Water Horse crosses from midnight into pale water, its amber thread still unbroken. Kelpie leaves you with a grounded starting point: choose deliberately, understand the rules, retain control.
shots.camera: Follow the amber thread low across the surface, sweep upward beside the horse's long profile as it passes through a rising midnight-water sheet, then pull back toward the widening pale horizon.
shots.action: Peel the sheet into long reflective ribbons without altering the official horse's anatomy. Its kelp mane streams across the night-day seam; amber reflections reveal the text kelpie.network above a moving dark-water channel. Keep the horse, ribbons, and parallax moving while the text remains legible. Let the final phrase resolve into water and a restrained harmonic release, never a static end card.
